validation_ack.reason: FY2021 basic EPS (Rp-141.52) uses weighted-average shares of 21,521,298,397 (audited FS2021 PDF p. 174, Note 'Laba per saham'), while shares_out is the year-end 22,746,526,712: MESOP exercises added 249,376,451 shares (listed 27 May 2021) and 99,314,846 (14 Sep 2021), and the PMHMETD IX rights issue added 1,054,545,185 shares listed 2 Dec 2021 (AR2021 PDF p. 120). Loss Rp3,045,701,407 thousand / 21,521,298,397 = -141.52: the gap is real.

FY2022 basic EPS (Rp0.50) uses weighted-average shares of 22,749,981,294 (audited FS2022 PDF p. 176) because the PMHMETD X rights issue added 1,993,201,832 shares only in late Dec 2022 (listed 26 Dec 2022, AR2022 PDF p. 130); year-end shares_out is 24,740,107,814. Profit Rp11,460,505 thousand / 22,749,981,294 = 0.504, printed 0.50 (two decimals): the gap is real.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every Bank Raya document was downloaded directly from bankraya.co.id (no bot protection) on 2026-11-03. The IR pages list files through the JSON endpoint https://bankraya.co.id/reports-data/<category>; each file is served at https://bankraya.co.id/uploads/reports/<file> (the URLs in source_url) and, identically, via /report-download/<id>. idx.co.id was not needed. One news article (Bisnis.com, via web.archive.org) supplies the PMHMETD IX ex-date.

ENTITY / BASIS: Bank Raya has no subsidiaries (only minority stakes in two BPRs and Lintasarta, 'Penyertaan saham' Rp77.5mn), so its stand-alone audited FS are the whole reporting entity: money figures are stored as 'consolidated' and equity_attr = total_equity (no NCI). Ratios are the bank's OJK individual ratios ('bank_only'). FS money values are printed in Rp ribu (thousands) and were divided by 1,000,000; published reports are in Rp juta.

NAME / CONTROL: legal name PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk since the EGMS of 27 Sep 2021 (AHU-0052731.AH.01.02.Tahun 2021; OJK KEP-65/PB.1/2021 of 1 Nov 2021); formerly PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Agroniaga Tbk (BRI Agro), ticker AGRO unchanged. BRI held 86.85% at 31 Dec 2025 (FS2025 Note 25). Since 2025-2026 the decks carry the Danantara Indonesia mark (BRI's state holding), the Bank Raya logo is unchanged.

LOSS YEARS (real data): FY2021 net loss Rp3,045.7bn (provisions Rp3,885bn while exiting legacy middle-segment loans; loans -40%, assets -40%), FY2025 net loss Rp498.6bn (NPL gross 14.02%, provisions Rp553.6bn, recoveries down, Rp176.9bn tax expense as the deferred tax asset went to nil). FY2021 ROE -95.44%, ROA -14.75% and BOPO 287.86% are outside the validator's plausible ranges; they are the bank's printed values, not unit slips. EPS is negative in FY2021 and FY2025.

RATIO SOURCES / DEFINITIONS: FY ratios come from each year's own December published report (Laporan Publikasi, OJK format, audited): ROA = pre-tax ROA (OJK); ROE = after-tax ROE on average Tier 1 (OJK). From FY2023 the reports print both before- and after-tax ROA/ROE (both quoted in notes). Values agree with the AR2021/AR2022/AR2023/AR2025 five-year tables except AR2025's FY2021 column, which swaps the ROE labels and misprints ROA after tax as (113.60%). CASA = AR 'Komposisi Dana Murah' (matches FS components). NPL coverage from the BoC/BoD reports (FY2020, FY2021, FY2023) and the FY24 deck (FY2022, FY2024).

NOT DISCLOSED (null): CoC every year (no credit-cost ratio in any AR, published report or deck); LaR for FY2020-FY2025 (the OJK report adds 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah' only in 2026, stored for the interim); NPL coverage FY2025 and 9M2026. The FY2025 and 3Q26 decks are mostly images and were read visually (pages 10 and 14/16).

RESTATEMENTS: none. Each audited FS's prior-year comparative equals the prior year's own figures (TA, loans, deposits, equity, profit) for FY2019-FY2024. Note AR2025's five-year balance-sheet table (PDF p. 35) misprints FY2023 deposits as 8,133,053 (the FY2024 value; FS2023: 8,185,976) and FY2021 deposits as 22,995,279 (the FY2020 value; FS2021: 13,496,292); the FS values are stored. FY2020 equity fell despite a profit because of the PSAK 71 opening adjustment (-Rp318.3bn retained earnings, 1 Jan 2020).

DIVIDENDS: no cash dividend out of FY2020-FY2025 profit (AGMS 9 Apr 2021, 31 Mar 2022, 10 May 2023, 30 Apr 2024, 25 Jun 2025, 20 May 2026), so there are no dividend records and payout_ratio = 0 each year. The last dividend was approved by the AGMS of 28 Mar 2019 (FY2018 profit; AR2025 PDF p. 235). Unappropriated retained earnings were -Rp3,255.6bn at 31 Dec 2025.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026: two rights issues - PMHMETD IX (ex 29 Nov 2021, 620,000:30,141 at Rp1,100, 1,054,545,185 shares) and PMHMETD X (ex 9 Dec 2022, 11,373,452,991:1,160,000,000 at Rp500, 1,993,201,832 shares). No split, reverse split or bonus issue ever (par value Rp100 since the 2003 IPO; FS2025 Note 1c chronology). No rights issue in 2019 or 2020: issued shares stayed 21,343,290,230 from PUT VIII (Sep 2018) to 31 Dec 2020 (FS2019/FS2020). Not recorded as corporate actions (no schema type): MESOP exercises (348,691,297 shares in 2021, 379,270 in 2022, 386,480 in 2023; programme expired 26 Jun 2023) and share buybacks (22,817,600 treasury shares at end-2024, 65,669,600 at end-2025, 74,979,400 at 30 Sep 2026). The EGMS of 9 Oct 2026 only amended the articles and the board (no capital action).
SHARE_BASIS: AGRO has never split its shares, so share_basis is the period-end date for EPS, shares_out and prices. shares_out is net of treasury shares (FY2024, FY2025, 9M2026).

INTERIM: 9M 2026 (30 Sep 2026) from the unaudited interim FS and the OJK published report (both released 29 Oct 2026) and the 3Q26 corporate presentation. Prior-year loans/deposits come from the 30 Sep 2025 interim FS. 9M2026 profit Rp21.0bn vs Rp42.0bn; loans fell to Rp6,468.8bn after strategic write-offs, NPL gross 2.53% (from 14.02% at Dec 2025).

SELF-CHECK: eps x shares_out vs net_profit_attr: 2020 -0.3%, 2021 +5.7% (rights + MESOP; acknowledged), 2022 +7.9% (rights; acknowledged), 2023 -0.4%, 2024 +0.05%, 2025 -0.04%. Year-end price x issued shares equals the AR market capitalisation (e.g. 2025: 230 x 24,740,494,294 = Rp5,690.3bn). LDR = loans/deposits from the FS to 2 dp every year.
